fig1 = px.line(
    trip_long.loc[:,['date','label','trips']], 
    x='date', 
    y='trips',

    title="California AV Trips by Company and Permit Type"

)

    legend=dict(
        title='',
        orientation='h'
        )
    )

# Safety

## Row

```{python}
fig9 = px.scatter_map(
    crash_geo_sev,
    lat='lat',
    lon='lng',
    size='Total',
    #color='Total',
    #color_continuous_scale='orrd',
    color_discrete_sequence=['#c1121f'],
    size_max=70,
    hover_name='city',
    hover_data=severity_order,
    title='Crashes by Severity',
    zoom=3
).update_layout(
    map_style="basic",
    margin={"r":0,"t":0,"l":0,"b":0},
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            buttons=list([
                dict(
                    args=[{"marker.size":crash_geo_sev[severity].to_numpy()}],
                    label=severity,
                    method="restyle",
                ) for severity in ['Total'] + severity_order
            ]),
            bgcolor=None,
            direction="down",
            showactive=True,
            x=0.025,
            xanchor="left",
            y=0.975,
            yanchor="top"
        ),
    ]
)
fig9.show()
```

```{python}
fig10 = px.scatter_map(
    crash_geo_comp,
    lat='lat',
    lon='lng',
    size='Total',
    #color='Total',
    #color_continuous_scale='orrd',
    color_discrete_sequence=['#003049'],
    size_max=70,
    hover_name='city',
    hover_data=comp_crashtot_descending[:5],
    title='Crashes by Company',
    zoom=3
).update_layout(
    map_style="basic",
    margin={"r":0,"t":0,"l":0,"b":0},
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            buttons=list([
                dict(
                    args=[{"marker.size":crash_geo_comp[company].to_numpy()}],
                    label=company,
                    method="restyle"
                ) for company in comp_crashtot_descending 
            ]),
            direction="down",
            showactive=True,
            x=0.025,
            xanchor="left",
            y=0.975,
            yanchor="top",
        ),
    ]
)
fig10.show()
```
